milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted yellow_dye item ends up in the player's inventory after crafting from a dandelion. The player starts with only dandelions (no yellow_dye), so this rule is not pre-satisfied. The dandelion→yellow_dye recipe is a 1:1 shapeless recipe that works in either the 2×2 personal crafting grid or the nearby crafting table.
